verdict_confidence: consistency-verdict, not an exact recomputation - see limitations

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources.quote: At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.

Q Dark Sphere Magic Damage 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP); W Force of Will Magic Damage 70/100/130/160/190 (+65% AP); E Scatter the Weak Magic Damage 60/95/130/165/200 (+60% AP); R Unleashed Power Magic Damage per Sphere 80/120/160 (+20% AP), Minimum 240/360/480 (+60% AP) [3 spheres], Maximum 560/840/1120 (+140% AP) [7 spheres]

splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff; R reads 'Magic Damage per Sphere' x user-set sphere count. The one damage.execute atom (R at 100 splinters, kills below 15% max HP) is explicitly documented as not modeled ('the fight target never dies').
E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres).
R_final = max(0, (R - r_flat)*(1 - r_pct/100)*(1 - p) - f)

the mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance ... The engine prices the threshold as a display row and does *not* add execute damage to totals - the kill boundary is documented, not double-counted.

step_0_source_reconstruction.claim: The cached W 'Bonus True Damage' leveling row is exactly the algebraic expansion of the description formula, so the wiki text is self-consistent and usable.
step_0_source_reconstruction.work: bonus_true(rank r) = (0.12 + 0.02*AP/100) * (W_flat[r] + 0.65*AP) = 0.12*W_flat[r] + (0.078 + 0.0002*W_flat[r])*AP + 0.00013*AP^2. Evaluating: flat = 8.4/12/15.6/19.2/22.8 (matches S6 exactly); linear = 9.2/9.8/10.4/11.0/11.6 % AP (matches S6 exactly); quadratic = 1.3 % AP per 100 AP (S6 caches 1.14 - a wiki-template rounding/rank artifact on the quadratic term only, flagged below).
step_0_source_reconstruction.conclusion: W bonus true damage = (12% + 2% per 100 AP) x W magic damage, confirmed from two independent renderings of the same cached wiki entry.

step_1_what_120_splinters_means.work: At splinters = 120 every Transcendent threshold is met: 40 (Q second charge, S2), 60 (W bonus true damage, S3), 80 (E slow - utility, no damage), 100 (R execute, S4), 120 (+15% ability power, S1). Four of the five thresholds are damage-affecting and every one of them is damage-INCREASING. Per S11 the R execute is priced as a boundary and not added to totals, so it cannot account for either value.
step_1_what_120_splinters_means.conclusion: A correct splinters=120 fight total must be >= the same fight with any of these bonuses missing. The leaf moved UP by 713.0 (+13.03%), i.e. in the direction of MORE sourced kit being applied.

step_2_eliminate_the_capstone_alone_(pur.work: If only the +15% AP capstone (S1) toggled and the damage were pure magic, then delta/D_old = 0.15*phi where phi = AP-scaled share of raw damage = 1/(1 + (F/C)/AP), F = sum of flat bases, C = sum of AP ratios. Over Syndra's rows the most AP-weighted is W with F/C = 190/0.65 = 292.3, so phi <= AP/(AP+292.3). Observed delta/D_old = 713.0/5472.5 = 0.1302878 requires phi = 0.86859, hence AP >= 1932.
step_2_eliminate_the_capstone_alone_(pur.conclusion: AP ~1932 is out of range for any Summoner's Rift Syndra build (a maxed AP build with the 15% buff tops out near 1200-1300), so the delta is NOT the capstone acting on magic damage alone. (Once the capstone's effect on the quadratic W true-damage term is included the capstone-only hypothesis becomes feasible again at AP ~850-1250 with 3+ W casts - so this step eliminates only the pure-magic form, not the capstone as such.)

hypothesis_A_Q2_second_charge.formula: delta = m * (230 + 0.70 * 1.15*AP),  m = 100/(100+R_eff),  R_eff = max(0, MR*(1-pct_pen) - flat_pen)   [S5, S1, S9, S10]
hypothesis_A_Q2_second_charge.worked_example: Target MR 60 vs Void Staff (40%) + Sorcerer's Shoes (18 flat): R_eff = max(0, 60*0.6 - 18) = 18 -> m = 100/118 = 0.847458. AP 760 -> AP_eff = 1.15*760 = 874 -> Q raw = 230 + 0.70*874 = 841.80 -> post-mitigation = 713.39.
hypothesis_A_Q2_second_charge.inverse: the delta is met exactly at AP_eff = 873.34 (base AP 759.4) for the same mitigation
hypothesis_A_Q2_second_charge.assessment: matches the observed +713.0 to within 0.4 at an entirely ordinary Syndra stat line

hypothesis_B_W_bonus_true_damage.formula: delta = n_W * (0.12 + 0.02*AP_eff/100) * (190 + 0.65*AP_eff)   [S3, S5, S6] - true damage, unmitigated (CLAUDE.md domain rule; S11)
hypothesis_B_W_bonus_true_damage.assessment: matches at 3-4 Force of Will casts over the fight window at ordinary AP

step_3_delta_is_one_sourced_damage_insta.conclusion: The delta is the size of exactly one sourced 120-splinter damage instance - either the 40-splinter second Dark Sphere charge or the 60-splinter W bonus true damage row (or the capstone acting through both magic and the true-damage term). Every fitting decomposition is a bonus that the cached wiki text says IS active at 120 Splinters.

step_4_rule_out_over_application.work: Over-application signatures were checked against the same rows: a doubled +15% AP capstone (1.15^2 = 1.3225 on the AP-scaled share) yields +19% to +21% on a Syndra rotation; a duplicated rotation roughly doubles the total; a duplicated R barrage at 7 spheres (1120 + 140% AP) is >= 1500 post-mitigation at any realistic AP. None of these lands near +713.0 / +13.03%.
step_4_rule_out_over_application.conclusion: the magnitude is one sourced instance, not a duplication artifact

limitations: The scenario input tuple for 'syndra_custom_order_120' (level, ability ranks, item/AP line, r_spheres, cast order, fight window, manual target stats) lives in scripts/, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids reading. It is not present anywhere in data/ (checked: practice-corpus/scenarios.json, worklists/, champion-audit/, atoms/, wiki/, wiki-atoms/, staleness.json) nor in docs/math-foundations.md.

Consequently the leaf could not be recomputed as an absolute number. The inverse problem (recover AP, target MR and cast multiset from two totals) is underdetermined: a grid search over the wiki-sourced Syndra rows found hundreds of (AP, MR, cast-multiset) tuples reproducing 5472.5 -> 6185.5.

What IS determinate and is the basis of the verdict: every decomposition of the +713.0 delta that fits the sourced rows corresponds to a 120-splinter Transcendent bonus that data/champions.json says is active, and no sourced 120-splinter mechanic reduces damage.

Residual risk not excludable from data/ alone: a change that adds a cast the scenario's custom order should not contain would produce the same delta shape as one that restores a cast it should. Nothing in the cached sources indicates that, but it cannot be positively excluded without the scenario tuple.
asides: data/champions.json Syndra W 'Bonus True Damage' leveling row caches the quadratic term as 1.14 % AP per 100 AP; the description formula (12% + 2% per 100 AP of a 190 +65% AP payload) gives 1.30 (= 0.02 * 0.65). The flat and linear terms match exactly, so only the quadratic term is off - it is consistent with a 57% AP ratio (0.02 * 57 = 1.14), i.e. a stale wiki template term. Any code reading that row directly rather than the description formula would understate W's true damage by ~12% of its AP-squared component. The row's units are also garbled ('  2'), a known-degraded parse.
data/staleness.json records for Syndra: "W[0] Bonus True Damage matched SlowDuration" - a false-positive game-file mapping for that same row; the row is effectively unverified against game files.
